title: Identification of Promising Genotypes
author: Ding Mingliang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.984h9yw

steps.title: Average Yield Data
steps.instruction: Average the yield data generated for genotypes across locations and years.

steps.title: Perform Variance-Weighted Analysis
steps.instruction: Perform Welch’s variance-weighted analysis of variance using a One-Way ANOVA model in SAS University Edition version 3.8, incorporating a Levene test for homogeneity of variance and the Tukey comparison method.

substeps.instruction: Analyze studied genotypes across years and locations.
Analyze at each location across genotypes and years.
Analyze for each year across genotypes and locations.

steps.title: Partition Promising Genotypes
steps.instruction: Use the calculated mean values to facilitate the partitioning of promising genotypes, locations, and years.
